visualCharacteristics: Dark-background two-column promotional band. Image/graphic on one side; on the other an eyebrow, heading, a paragraph with an inline link, and a 'more' link. White text on a dark blue band.
contentPattern: One row with two columns: an image column and a text column (eyebrow + heading + paragraph + link).
usage: Promotional/news callout pairing a graphic with supporting text on a dark section band.
